conditions: One TP4/DCP1 run on four directly cabled NVIDIA DGX Sparks using the pinned checkpoint and maintainer-held source runtime described below; native prefix caching enabled; external key-value caching and SIRCL disabled.

runtime.source_archive_status: maintainer-held; no public image or archive; public reproduction pending

correctness.native_prefix_replay: 8992-token replay returned identical output; timing omitted because the public record lacks a complete timing method
correctness.shared_prefix_divergence: 13 and 17 returned for distinct suffix questions

mtp_post_probe_snapshot.scope: post-probe server metric snapshot; not a whole-window average

correctness.raw_artifact_status: maintainer-held; request and response artifacts are unavailable in the public record

measurement.argument_equivalent_command: python3 llm_decode_bench.py --host <rank-0-management-address> --port 8000 --model qwen38 --contexts 4k,16k --concurrency 1,4 --duration 15 --max-tokens 1024 --temperature 0 --prefill-contexts 8k,64k,128k --prefill-metric client --kv-budget 8382750 --display-mode plain --no-hw-monitor --output logs/qwen38-dgx4-quick-20260823.json
measurement.decode_aggregation: OpenAI continuous-usage completion tokens divided by the measured duration window
measurement.decode_warmup: one hidden C1 warmup at the largest requested context for 3 seconds, followed by each cell's readiness warmup
measurement.prefill_definition: one integrated or scout-only request; client prompt_tokens divided by client TTFT
measurement.prefix_cache_state: native prefix caching enabled; each duration cell first sent a one-token scout with the same messages, so its C1/C4 streams deliberately reused a warm prefix; the client-metric run did not preserve a reliable cached-token delta for the scout measurements, so no prefill value is labelled cold or unique-prompt
measurement.raw_record_status: maintainer-held validation-workspace artifact; unavailable in the public repository because it contains site identities

gates.duration_stream_completion_note: streams were intentionally canceled at the end of each window; no finite-request completion or latency claim is made

measurement.uncertainty: one observation per coordinate; no repetition variance or confidence interval

post_run.memory_measurement: one post-run /proc/meminfo MemAvailable sample per rank, rounded down to GiB

result: All ranks rendezvoused and remained alive; bounded text, tool, image, and hybrid-prefix probes returned expected outputs; every C1/C4 duration cell reached requested occupancy without errors, underfill, warmup timeout, or a capacity flag.
conclusion: The pinned model and maintainer-held runtime implemented the stated four-Spark TP4/DCP1 serving object. The N=1 observations do not establish general performance, complete correctness, restart behavior, or public reproducibility.
limitations: Each benchmark coordinate is one bounded observation; no confidence interval is established.
The decode matrix covers warm repeated-prefix C1 and C4 only, at 4K and 16K contexts; it is not cold end-to-end request throughput.
The 64K and 128K cells are single scout TTFT observations, not long-context generation tests.
Native prefix caching was enabled, and no scout has a reliable cached-token delta; the prefill values are not cold or unique-prompt measurements.
No restart, reboot persistence, eager-versus-graph equivalence, LMCache, or SparkCache result is included.
The exact runtime archive, raw benchmark output, API responses, and per-rank logs remain maintainer-held and are unavailable in the public artifact.
The initial container start exposed a missing userspace verbs dependency; maintainer-held failure logs precede installation of libibverbs1, ibverbs-providers, and ibverbs-utils.
